entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I'm... I'm calling about a jersey I bought a little while ago. I'm just so disappointed, I don't know what to do.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the wrong size. I was so excited to get it, I saved up for it, but it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I can barely move in it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I've never had this happen.

I understand how frustrating that must be, especially when you're looking forward to using new gear. Let me pull up your account... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 51 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I just feel so bad about it. I really needed that money for other things, and now I have a jersey I can't even wear. I was hoping I could still return it.

Of course. Let me just check the policy for that item. One moment... Okay, I have good news for you. That jersey is a standard apparel item, which is covered by our 10-day return policy. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, we can absolutely process this for you.
Would you prefer to exchange it for a different size, or would you like a full refund?
Oh, really? You can do that? Oh, thank you so much! That's such a relief. A full refund would be amazing, if that's possible.

Absolutely possible. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the jersey back up, apply the label, and drop it at any shipping center. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. Isaac, you've really turned my day around. Thank you for being so helpful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
